name: Carpet or Hardwood? Room-by-Room in an Issaquah Home
title-tag: Carpet vs Hardwood, Room by Room: An Issaquah Guide
meta-description: Carpet vs hardwood decided the honest way — room by room. Bedrooms, stairs, family rooms and basements each have a right answer, plus the resale nuance.
post-summary: December 3, 2026 · Carpet versus hardwood is a room-by-room decision, not a house-wide one. Bedrooms are carpet's best room and it is not close; kitchens and main floors lean hardwood; stairs are a genuine argument. The per-room verdicts, the real costs, and the resale advice most articles get wrong.
